lines.japanese: 「おはよう小鳥さんたち！」
lines.english: “Good morning, little birdies!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの家を出たあとの彼女はとても、というより異常なほどのハイテンションだった。
lines.english: Once we had left her apartment, Watarai was in extremely—no, alarmingly—high spirits.

lines.japanese: 周りのみんなの目が気になって、僕はちょっと恥ずかしかった。もちろん嬉しくはあるんだけど。
lines.english: I felt a little embarrassed, conscious of the people around us. Happy, of course, but embarrassed all the same.

lines.japanese: 「やー、今日はほんっと気持ちのいい朝だよね！」
lines.english: “Ahh, what an absolutely gorgeous morning!”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「なんてーかこう、スキップとかしたくなっちゃうよね！」
lines.english: I dunno, mornings like this just make you wanna skip, y'know!

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。あのさ、渡来さん」
lines.english: “Yeah. Um, Watarai...”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ、いいよ！」
lines.english: “Mm-hm! Of course!”

lines.japanese: 「僕まだなにも言ってない」
lines.english: “I haven't said anything yet.”

lines.japanese: もう少し静かに登校しようよ、なんて野暮なことを言いかけたけどやめた。
lines.english: I had been about to say something hopelessly dull about walking to school a little more quietly, but thought better of it.

lines.japanese: 僕は楽しそうな渡来さんが好きだ。周りのみんなを気にしてそれを止めるなんてもったいない。
lines.english: I loved seeing Watarai enjoy herself. It would be a terrible waste to stop her just because I was worried about what other people might think.

lines.japanese: そのとき後ろから後輩の女子に追いぬかれた。なんだか驚いた顔でこっちを見ていた気がする。
lines.english: Just then, a girl from one of the lower grades passed us. I thought she gave us a startled look on her way by.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが彼女に向けて軽く手を上げた。笑顔でなにか一言添えていたけど、なんて言ったかは聞きとれなかった。
lines.english: Watarai raised a hand in casual greeting. She added something with a smile, but I could not make out what she said.

lines.japanese: 「知り合い？」
lines.english: “Do you know her?”

lines.japanese: 「前に委員会で会ったことある子。挨拶くらいはね」
lines.english: “We met through a committee once. We say hello, that's all.”

lines.japanese: そういえば、今朝はやたら早足のひとが多いなあ。さっきから後ろのひとに追いぬかれてばかりだ──
lines.english: Come to think of it, there sure were a lot of people walking fast this morning. People behind us had been passing us this whole time—

lines.japanese: ──違うか。僕らがのんびり歩きすぎなんだ。
lines.english: —or maybe not. We were just walking way too slowly.

lines.japanese: 「彼氏と一緒に登校っていいものだね。興味ない男子が勝手に寄ってきたりとかしないし」
lines.english: “Walking to school with your boyfriend is pretty nice. Guys you’re not interested in don’t just come up to you.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいやいや、でもなんか照れるね。青春だね。若さ満点だね」
lines.english: “No, no, no—but this is embarrassing, isn't it? This is youth. One hundred percent pure youth.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、ほんとに楽しそうだね」
lines.english: “You really are enjoying yourself, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: でも考えてみれば、僕が誰かと一緒に学校へ行くなんてことは初めてなんだ。渡来さんの言うとおり、今朝の登校は楽しい。そう、心から思えた。
lines.english: But now that I thought about it, I had never gone to school with anyone before. Watarai was right: the walk to school this morning was fun. I could feel that with all my heart.

lines.japanese: 「うん、意外。恋愛ってこういうのだったんだ。みんながハマるのも分かる気はするね。まあ──」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. What a surprise. So this is what romance is like. I think I can see why everyone gets hooked on it. Although—”

lines.japanese: ──視野がそれ一色になるような生き方はしたくないけど、と彼女は付けたした。僕からもそうあってほしいと願う。
lines.english: —she would never want it to color her whole view of the world, she added. I hoped it never would.

lines.japanese: 僕は乙女な渡来さんも好きだけど、やっぱりいちばん好きなのは、世界のみんなとはちょっと違う座標に立って、ぼんやり空や街を眺めている彼女だから。
lines.english: I loved this romantic side of Watarai too. But the Watarai I loved most was still the girl who stood at coordinates just a little removed from everyone else in the world and gazed dreamily at the sky and the city.

lines.japanese: 「うちのダーリンも、恋愛にハマりすぎて浮気したりしちゃ駄目よ？」
lines.english: “And my darling mustn't get so addicted to romance that he goes off and cheats on me, all right?”

lines.japanese: 「もう……だから山科さんはそんなんじゃないって」
lines.english: “Honestly... I keep telling you, there's nothing like that between Yamashina and me.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、まだまだ敵は多いの。たとえば羽田君のことを毎日見てるあそこの下級生とかっ！」
lines.english: “Oh, I still have plenty of enemies. Like that girl in the lower grades over there who watches you every single day!”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、なにそれ」
lines.english: “What? Where did that come from?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いま嬉しそうな顔した？」
lines.english: “Did you just look pleased?”

lines.japanese: 「してないよ。むしろ渡来さんにからかわれて困った顔してるんだよ」
lines.english: “No. If anything, I look flustered because you’re teasing me.”

lines.japanese: 「山科だってさ、羽田君にその気はなくても、ひょっとしたら向こうはそうじゃないかもでしょ」
lines.english: “Even if you don't feel anything for Yamashina, she might feel differently about you.”

lines.japanese: 「やめなよ、山科さんに聞こえたら失礼だよ」
lines.english: “Stop that. It would be rude if Yamashina heard you.”

lines.japanese: 「高内も油断できないな。あの子、一年のころ羽田君に色目使ってたし」
lines.english: “And I can't let my guard down around Takauchi. She used to make eyes at you in our first year.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか、それこそありえないって。僕を好きになるのなんて、渡来さんみたいなおかしいひとぐらいだよ」
lines.english: “No chance. That's even more impossible. The only person strange enough to fall for me is someone like you.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: What'd you say?

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめん」
lines.english: “S-sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「……ま、いっか」
lines.english: “...Oh, never mind.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはぴたっと足を止めて僕に顔を向ける。相変わらずなにをやっても様になるひとだ。
lines.english: Watarai stopped dead and turned to face me. As ever, she could make anything she did look perfect.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。たぶん私がしてるのは恋愛じゃなくて、羽田愛なんだ」
lines.english: “I've got it. What I feel probably isn't romance. It's Haneda-love.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、いよいよ意味が分からないよ渡来さん」
lines.english: “No, Watarai. Now you've finally lost me.”

lines.japanese: 「フィーリングで分かってよ。もう幼い日の私にかけて誓うね、私は七兆回のきっかけがあれば、七兆回とも羽田君を好きになると」
lines.english: “Feel your way to the answer. I swear upon the little girl I used to be: given seven trillion chances, I would fall in love with you all seven trillion times.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「食いつき悪いね」
lines.english: “You're not biting.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ。すごく嬉しい。でも人間の寿命はそんなに長くないから、物理的に考えて七兆回もきっかけは来ないと思うんだ」
lines.english: That's not true. I'm really happy. But people don't live that long, so I don't think we're physically going to get seven trillion chances.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、まずはこのマジレス癖を直させないとナー」
lines.english: Hmm, first I gotta cure you of that habit of taking every joke seriously.

lines.japanese: 「だから、今この一回の出会いに、七兆回分の恋を詰めこんじゃえばいいんじゃないかな」
lines.english: “Then why don't we pack seven trillion loves into this one chance we've been given?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、こっちの悪癖は残しときたいんだけどナー」
lines.english: Hmm, but this is one bad habit I kinda wanna keep.

lines.japanese: 「あははは」
lines.english: “Ahahaha.”

lines.japanese: なんだか今日の空はやけに高く感じる。いつもとなにか変わったんだろうか。
lines.english: For some reason, the sky felt extraordinarily high today. Had something about it changed?

lines.japanese: そう思って空を見上げてみても、そこにあるのはいつものくすんだ白だった。
lines.english: But when I looked up, all I saw was the same dull white as ever.

lines.japanese: 「日常って素敵だね」
lines.english: “Normal life is pretty great, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そこに羽田君がいればね」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. When you're in it.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ毎日を素敵にしてみせるよ」
lines.english: “Then I'll make every day wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「やめて。これから学校だってのに集中できなくなっちゃう。羽田の底へ落ちてっちゃう。私も一応乙女だから。なんちゃって」
lines.english: “Stop. We’re about to go to school, and now I won’t be able to concentrate. I’m sinking into the depths of Haneda. I’m a girl at heart, you know. Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: 横を見れば初恋のひと。すぐそこで微笑んでいる僕の彼女。
lines.english: Beside me walked my first love. My girlfriend, smiling right there within arm's reach.

lines.japanese: 約束しよう、このきっかけに。約束しよう、この恋心に。
lines.english: Let me make a promise to this chance that brought us together. Let me make a promise to this love.

lines.japanese: これからもこの限りない日常を続けていきたいと思った。
lines.english: I wanted this boundless everyday life of ours to go on and on.

lines.japanese: さよならグレタガルド。
lines.english: Farewell, Gretagard.

lines.japanese: 「世界は金色に包まれているのだー」
lines.english: “The world is bathed in gold!”
